control_operation.title: control_operation
control_operation.description: MQTT reference for control_operation: START or STOP the RFID radio (or the barcode scanner) on demand over the control (CTRL) endpoint — the command that starts and stops the tag data stream on the DATA endpoints.

get_operating_mode.title: get_operating_mode
get_operating_mode.description: MQTT reference for get_operating_mode: read back the RFID operating-mode configuration — profile, Gen2 query, pre-filters — over the control (CTRL) endpoint.

get_post_filter.title: get_post_filter
get_post_filter.description: MQTT reference for get_post_filter: read back the reader's current post-filter rules (per data endpoint) that include/exclude scanned tag data before reporting, over the control (CTRL) endpoint.

set_operating_mode.title: set_operating_mode
set_operating_mode.description: MQTT reference for set_operating_mode: configure RFID operating mode — profile, triggers, Gen2 query, access operations — over the control (CTRL) endpoint.

set_post_filter.title: set_post_filter
set_post_filter.description: MQTT reference for set_post_filter: add, delete, or modify a post-filter rule that includes/excludes scanned tag data (by prefix, suffix, or regex) per data endpoint, over the control (CTRL) endpoint.

config_endpoint.title: config_endpoint
config_endpoint.description: MQTT reference for config_endpoint: add, update, or delete an MQTT endpoint configuration on the reader — protocol, broker URL/port, TLS, topics, and credentials — over the management endpoint.

config_events.title: config_events
config_events.description: MQTT reference for config_events: enable or disable event streams, set the heartbeat interval, and set alert thresholds, over the management endpoint.

delete_certificate.title: delete_certificate
delete_certificate.description: MQTT reference for delete_certificate: remove a certificate from the reader's trust store by name and type over the management endpoint. Omitting name bulk-deletes every certificate of the type.

delete_wifi_profile.title: delete_wifi_profile
delete_wifi_profile.description: MQTT reference for delete_wifi_profile: permanently remove a saved Wi-Fi profile from the reader by ESSID over the management endpoint. The active (connected) profile is firmware-protected.

get_current_region.title: get_current_region
get_current_region.description: MQTT reference for get_current_region: a read-only query returning the active region, channel plan, and power limits over the management endpoint.

get_endpoint_config.title: get_endpoint_config
get_endpoint_config.description: MQTT reference for get_endpoint_config: read back the active MQTT endpoint configurations and every saved endpoint name over the management endpoint.

get_eth.title: get_eth
get_eth.description: MQTT reference for get_eth: a read-only query returning wired Ethernet interface state, link status and speed, and DHCP IPv4 over the management endpoint.

get_installed_certificates.title: get_installed_certificates
get_installed_certificates.description: MQTT reference for get_installed_certificates: list the certificates in the reader's trust store (metadata only, no private keys) over the management endpoint.

get_status.title: get_status
get_status.description: MQTT reference for get_status: a read-only, on-demand device-health snapshot returning power, radio, clock, terminal, and battery status over the management endpoint.

get_version.title: get_version
get_version.description: MQTT reference for get_version: a read-only query returning reader identity — model, serial, SKU, firmware, components — over the management endpoint.

get_wifi.title: get_wifi
get_wifi.description: MQTT reference for get_wifi: a read-only query returning the saved Wi-Fi profiles, connection status, and IPv4 addressing over the management endpoint.

install_certificate.title: install_certificate
install_certificate.description: MQTT reference for install_certificate: add a certificate or key to the trust store by HTTP download or DIRECT inline content, over the management endpoint.

reboot.title: reboot
reboot.description: MQTT reference for reboot: a warm reset of the reader over the management endpoint. Asynchronous accept (code 1), session-severing; refused during inventory.

set_os.title: set_os
set_os.description: MQTT reference for set_os: an over-the-air firmware update from a .DAT image URL over the management endpoint. Asynchronous and session-severing.

set_wifi.title: set_wifi
set_wifi.description: MQTT reference for set_wifi: create or modify a Wi-Fi profile on the reader — interface, access point, security (WPA2-Personal, WPA2-Enterprise, WPA3-Personal, WPA3-Enterprise), and DHCP IPv4 — over the management endpoint.

alerts.title: alerts
alerts.description: MQTT reference for the alerts event: the alert envelope (type, state, id, priority) and the six alertDetails branches, on the management event topic.

heartBeatEVT.title: heartBeatEVT
heartBeatEVT.description: MQTT reference for the heartBeatEVT event: the periodic liveness signal — uptime, event sequence, inventory status, battery — on the management event topic.

mqttConnEVT.title: mqttConnEVT
mqttConnEVT.description: MQTT reference for the mqttConnEVT event: the per-endpoint CONNECTED and DISCONNECTED signal, published as the MQTT birth message and the Last Will on the rfid topic.

dataEVT.title: dataEVT
dataEVT.description: MQTT reference for the dataEVT event: tag reads during an active inventory — EPC, TID, and USER memory, RSSI telemetry, access results — on the DATA endpoint.
